scope: Final current source and compiled-package review only. Root owns the separate exact-APK emulator proof and visual observations. No phone-installed-version claim.

Loading a saved run gates remaining-inventory updates until the native resume handshake confirms the reconciled state.
Visible package version and SAVE control identify the current build; the screenshot alone does not identify the physical phone package.
Entire native JS/data/WASM and all maps/music/Duel remain identical to0.27. Its Greenhaven native save alias correction remains intact.
